question.text: The value of $\int \frac{(x-2)}{\left\{(x-2)^{2}(x+3)^{7}\right\rangle^{1 / 3}} d x$ is

solution.text:
Let $I=\int \frac{(x-2)}{\left\{(x-2)^{2}(x+3)^{7}\right\}^{1 / 3}} d x$
$$
\begin{array}{l}
=\int \frac{d x}{(x-2)^{-1 / 3}(x+3)^{7 / 3}} \\
=\int \frac{d x}{(x-2)^{2}\left(\frac{x+3}{x-2}\right)^{7 / 3}} \\
\text { Put } \frac{x+3}{x-2}=t \Rightarrow \frac{-5 d x}{(x-2)^{2}}=d t
\end{array}
$$
$\therefore \quad I=-\frac{1}{5} \int \frac{d t}{t^{7 / 3}}=-\frac{1}{5} \int t^{-7 / 3} d t$
$=-\frac{1}{5}\left[\frac{t^{-7 / 3+1}}{-\frac{7}{3}+1}\right]+C=-\frac{1}{5}\left[\frac{t^{-4 / 3}}{-\frac{4}{3}}\right]+C$
$=\frac{3}{20 t^{4 / 3}}+C=\frac{3}{20}\left(\frac{x-2}{x+3}\right)^{4 / 3}+C$
